answer: Grades are sealed when submitted and only opened at close, so graders cannot react to or copy each other, which prevents a Sybil cluster from coordinating its votes within a single jury. In practice this means a farm must spend real resources on every single alias, and that per-identity cost is what keeps the network honest at scale.. The design works because cost compounds over compute, time, and reputation, growing faster than the influence the cluster can extract. Consider a willow as the anchor of the cost.
